description: Presidential Secretariat - Resignation of Ministers from their Offices w.e.f. January 19,2023 and appointments of Ministers from January 19, 2023
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists named individuals (Hon. Keheliya Rambukwella, Hon. Amaraweera Mahinda, Hon. Vanniarachchi Pavithra Devi, Hon. Jeevan Thondaman) and their basic ministerial titles (e.g., "Minister of Water Supply", "Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation"). It does NOT include detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. The content focuses solely on government personnel changes (resignations and appointments), making it a People Gazette.
